name: RenameFile
label: Rename File(s)
description: Renames one or more files with advanced schemes including datetime and sequential numbering.

fields.name: FilesToRename
fields.label: File(s) to rename
fields.description: The path(s) of the file(s) to rename. Supports wildcards like *.txt.

fields.name: RenameScheme
fields.label: Rename scheme
fields.description: Specifies the rename scheme to apply.

selectOptions.label: Set new name
selectOptions.description: Sets a completely new name for the file.

selectOptions.label: Add text
selectOptions.description: Adds text to the existing file name.

selectOptions.label: Remove text
selectOptions.description: Removes specified text from the file name.

selectOptions.label: Replace text
selectOptions.description: Replaces specified text in the file name.

selectOptions.label: Add datetime
selectOptions.description: Appends a timestamp to the file name.

selectOptions.label: Make sequential
selectOptions.description: Renames the file with a sequential number.

fields.name: KeepExtension
fields.label: Keep extension
fields.description: Indicates whether to keep the original file extension.

fields.name: IfExistsAction
fields.label: If file exists
fields.description: Specifies the behavior when a file already exists in the destination folder.

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

fields.name: NewFileName
fields.label: New file name
fields.description: The new name for the file(s). Required for 'Set new name'.

fields.name: TextToAdd
fields.label: Text to add
fields.description: The text to append or prepend to the filename.

fields.name: AddTextPosition
fields.label: Add text position
fields.description: Where to add the text: before or after the filename.

fields.name: TextToRemove
fields.label: Text to remove
fields.description: The text to remove from the filename.

fields.name: TextToReplace
fields.label: Text to replace
fields.description: The text to be replaced in the filename.

fields.name: ReplaceWith
fields.label: Replace with
fields.description: The replacement text for the matched string.

fields.name: NewExtension
fields.label: New extension
fields.description: The new file extension (e.g., .pdf). Must include the dot (.).

fields.name: UseCustomDateTime
fields.label: Add datetime
fields.description: Appends a timestamp to the file name.

fields.name: DatetimeSource
fields.label: Datetime source
fields.description: Choose between current system time or a custom datetime value.

selectOptions.label: Custom datetime
selectOptions.description: Uses a custom datetime value (not yet implemented).

fields.name: AddDateTimePosition
fields.label: Add datetime position
fields.description: Where to place the datetime: before or after the filename.

fields.name: DateTimeSeparator
fields.label: Separator
fields.description: Character used to separate filename from datetime (e.g., '_', '-', '.').

fields.name: DateTimeFormat
fields.label: Datetime format
fields.description: Custom format for the datetime (e.g., yyyyMMdd_HHmmss). Leave empty for default.

fields.name: BaseFileName
fields.label: Make sequential
fields.description: Renames files with sequential numbers (e.g., File_001, File_002).

fields.name: AddNumberPosition
fields.label: Add number position
fields.description: Where to place the sequential number: before or after the base name.

fields.name: StartNumber
fields.label: Start numbering at
fields.description: The first number in the sequence (e.g., 1).

fields.name: IncrementBy
fields.label: Increment by
fields.description: How much to increase the number for each subsequent file (e.g., 1, 5).

fields.name: NumberSeparator
fields.label: Number separator
fields.description: Character used to separate filename from number (e.g., '_', '-', space).

fields.name: UsePadding
fields.label: Use padding
fields.description: Whether to pad numbers with leading zeros (e.g., 001, 010).

fields.name: MinDigits
fields.label: Minimum digits
fields.description: Minimum number of digits for padded numbers (e.g., 3 → 001, 002).

fields.name: RenamedFiles
fields.label: Renamed Files
fields.description: Returns the list of successfully renamed files.
